item.title: Death notice: Sherri (Haupt) Wayne
item.description: Sherri (Haupt) Wayne, sister, aunt, and friend, passed away on Aug. 23, 2026, at age 63, in her home in Juneau, Alaska. Born in Hampton, Iowa, Sherri will be remembered for her kindness, humor, generosity, and love for family and friends. She was proud of the life and career she built in Alaska as a programmer with the Alaska State Legislature. Sherri is survived by her sister, Kathy (Haupt) LePera of Ankeny, Iowa; nieces, nephews, great-nephew, and significant others. She was preceded in death by her parents. She will be missed and loved.
